subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw reserve `openclaw-even-g2-node` and allow matching `even-hub`/`glasses` clients to use the native setup-code bootstrap handoff?
rationale: This is not a mechanical bug fix: it adds a public wire client id and grants a new external device class a silent bootstrap path with bounded operator handoff, and the related proposal still asks for stable naming guidance.

options.title: Approve this narrow identity after rebase
options.body: Accept the new client id and signed metadata gate as the smallest Gateway-side seam, then keep app import and command policy work in the broader proposal.

options.title: Rename/generalize before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch this PR and the external app to a maintainer-approved durable id such as an Even Hub family id before landing.

options.title: Defer core recognition
options.body: Keep the external app on the explicit owner-approval path until maintainers settle the full Even Hub integration direction.

recommendation.title: Approve this narrow identity after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the new client id and signed metadata gate as the smallest Gateway-side seam, then keep app import and command policy work in the broader proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: The local history sample points to this handle on the relevant Gateway/protocol files, and the decision is a Gateway auth/security boundary choice.
